verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents a 'secure' code interpreter execution environment and an Access Control feature for role/group permissions, suggesting some isolation and permissioning exists, but there is no evidence of container/VM sandboxing for general tool/MCP runs or granular per-tool permission modes limiting what an agent can touch during execution. missing for 10: documented sandbox architecture (container/VM) for MCP tool calls, explicit tool-level permission/allowlist policies, and independent verification of isolation guarantees.
